data.narrative:
Riverlane is a Series C quantum computing company founded by Steve Brierley, evaluated within a competitive set of 3 public peers (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ. The company has raised $120M+ to date.

Given Riverlane's stage and sector, only one valuation method proved sufficiently grounded in available data. The stage-progression approach applied a 1.7x multiplier—typical for Series C advancement to the next funding round—to the $120M total raised as a valuation proxy, yielding $204M. A peer-median approach was inapplicable because the quantum computing peer set, while comprising 8 private firms, contained insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with disclosed valuations meeting analytical standards. Applying an all-sector median would risk material misalignment given quantum computing's distinct capital intensity and development timeline.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $173M to $235M, with a central estimate of $204M. This reflects the inherent uncertainty of valuing early-stage deeptech at a stage where few quantum peers have publicly disclosed recent financials at equivalent development phases. Key risk factors include the timing and success of technical milestones, capital efficiency relative to established peers, and quantum computing's nascent commercialization landscape. Broader market validation through comparable-company disclosure or transaction data would strengthen confidence in any point estimate.
